notes.title: Emo Quest XD: Patch 1 is now available!
notes.notes:
- Menu now wraps around
- Players won't be able to use healing items when their status are already full, preventing them from wasting the said items.
- Water shader is a bit less intense (just a little bit).
- Fixed some typos.

notes.title: Emo Quest XD is already available on Steam!
notes.notes: Finally I'm releasing my turn-based RPG here on Steam! I'll be hearing all feedback players give about it. I hope people can enjoy this game as much as I've enjoyed making it!
